calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_without_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_nondispatched', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_delivered_null_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_channel_WB_not900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders_lines_in_stores_not900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_test_or_999', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, s.store_id, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-08-25' AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21' AS in_range, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l2
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'dup_return_same_line' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, 0.0 AS amt FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_exceed_sold_qty', COUNT(*), 0 FROM (SELECT r.sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY r.sales_line_id, f.quantity HAVING SUM(r.quantity_returned) > f.quantity)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_orphan', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_test_lines_net_in_range', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount),0) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_test_returns_in_range', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_null_dispatch_or_odd_status', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status NOT IN ('delivered','collected','processing','cancelled')
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_sales_lines_store_not_900_but_return_900', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND s2.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_returns_booked_elsewhere', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND s2.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
